readBy: loop facts for the gate runner (#29), from a session's own tool calls: a wake-up or cron job it scheduled, with when it fires; one it cancelled; a background subagent it started, which keeps the session looping until its report arrives as a subagent prompt; and a shell command it started in the background, which keeps it looping until its end notice arrives the same way or its process group ends. Codex and pi hooks show no background shell call, so only Claude Code names one; for Codex (#39), from the records it keeps: each goal's status in the rollout, each heartbeat automation in its home, and its windows and billing from token events

windows.ignoredOtherwise: a token event's rate_limits with another limit_id, such as image_gen, says nothing of these windows

goals.record: a goal tool's output in the rollout, {"goal":{"threadId","status"}}, as the corpus's goal sessions hold it
